data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement stems from a tool error (HTTP 400) in the Qwen model when attempting to audit .gitignore, forcing an 'inconclusive' overall verdict. DeepSeek successfully audited the file and found it benign, leading to a 'safe' verdict.
coverage_issues: Qwen model failed to audit .gitignore due to an API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError).
learnings: The audit tool should handle individual file API errors gracefully, perhaps by skipping low-risk files like .gitignore or retrying, rather than failing the entire audit.
Models correctly recognized that standard VCS packaging patterns (SKIP checksums, git+https sources) and echo-only install scripts are not injection vectors.
